name: field
title: Field
description: Provides labeling, helper text, and validation error messages for form controls.

files.content:
import {
  FieldControl,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldItem,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldPrefix,
  FieldRoot,
  FieldSuffix,
  FieldValidity,
} from "./field";

/**
 * @see https://ui.awaiden.com/llms.mdx/docs/components/field/content.md
 */
export const Field = Object.assign(FieldRoot, {
  Control: FieldControl,
  Description: FieldDescription,
  Error: FieldError,
  Group: FieldGroup,
  Item: FieldItem,
  Label: FieldLabel,
  Prefix: FieldPrefix,
  Root: FieldRoot,
  Suffix: FieldSuffix,
  Validity: FieldValidity,
  control: FieldControl,
  description: FieldDescription,
  error: FieldError,
  group: FieldGroup,
  item: FieldItem,
  label: FieldLabel,
  prefix: FieldPrefix,
  root: FieldRoot,
  suffix: FieldSuffix,
  validity: FieldValidity,
});

export {
  FieldControl,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldItem,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldPrefix,
  FieldRoot,
  FieldSuffix,
  FieldValidity,
};

export type {
  FieldControlProps,
  FieldDescriptionProps,
  FieldErrorProps,
  FieldGroupProps,
  FieldItemProps,
  FieldLabelProps,
  FieldPrefixProps,
  FieldProps,
  FieldSuffixProps,
  FieldValidityProps,
} from "./field";
export { FieldContext, useFieldContext } from "./field.context";
export { type FieldVariants, fieldVariants } from "./field.variants";
